name: Vintage Story code mod
summary: A C# mod for Vintage Story: modinfo.json, a ModSystem and an assets folder, following the official mod template.
description: A class library the game loads as a code mod. The build puts the dll, modinfo.json and assets together in one folder and zips them, ready for the Mods folder. Needs Vintage Story installed to build, because the game's own dlls are the only source of its API.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: In lowercase without spaces it becomes the mod id, which must never change once people use the mod.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.
options.help: Shown in the game's mod manager.

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The folder with Vintagestory.exe. Leave empty to use the VINTAGE_STORY environment variable instead.

options.label: Target framework
options.help: Must match the .NET version the game runs on.

next: Open the folder in Visual Studio, Rider or VS Code.
The mod is bin\Release\{{ModId}}_{{Version}}.zip. Copy it to %APPDATA%\VintagestoryData\Mods.
Start the game and look for the mod's lines in %APPDATA%\VintagestoryData\Logs\client-main.log.
Your code starts in {{SystemClass}}.cs, in Start.
